snippet.title: Risk of Rain: Meridian Showcase 1
snippet.description:
Meridian is a small mod that is being worked on by me and Altzeus, it's primary focus is on adding more maps to the game! 

(Names of some maps won't be revealed until release)

MUSIC IN THIS STAGE IS A PLACEHOLDER, IT WILL GET ITS OWN THEME LATER ON DEVELOPMENT.

Mods used in this video that are not apart of Meridian:
Starstorm made by Neik 
Elite Icons made by retroPacifist
